floating_rate_source: 10-K FY2025, Note 12 Long-term debt: debt table p. F-26, unhedged balance p. F-28 [DEBT ¶61], cap table p. F-29 [DEBT ¶73, ¶95-¶100]; Item 7A p. 69 [7A ¶5]
floating_rate_quote: The remaining $368,559 outstanding principal balance of Term Loan A-2 is subject to SOFR-based interest rate volatility.
floating_rate_basis: Floating debt is Term Loan A-2 $2,000,000k + Term Loan B-2 $1,868,559k (SOFR + margin). Interest rate caps cover $3,500,000k of it in each year 2025-2028 and $1,000,000k in 2029, so only $368,559k of $10,159,463k debt principal (3.6%) is unhedged. Item 7A agrees: +100bp would cut net income by about $5.3M after caps. Not captured by 3.6%: the caps only pay above their strikes (weighted average 4.32% in 2026 rising to 4.50% in 2029, with 25bp step-ups at end-2026 and end-2027), and cover falls to $1.0B in 2029, inside a 5-year loan. Both are memo risks, not stress inputs.
